gappers.catalyst: Rocket Lab -11% as Neutron's first flight slips to 2027 (24/7 Wall St).
headlines: Rocket Lab Tumbles 11% as Neutron's First Flight Moves to 2027; SpaceX and AST SpaceMobile Pull Back
gappers.catalyst_detail: Neutron's maiden launch was pushed from 2026 to 2027. Space peers (SpaceX-linked SPCX, ASTS) are also down.
gappers.why: Delay defers the medium-lift revenue ramp that the premium valuation priced in, so growth multiples compress.
gappers.impact: Volume 305k premarket is heavy for a pre-market print. Sector-wide space selling plus a broad AI/tech risk-off (tech sector -2%) points to continued pressure, not a one-day spike.
gappers.horizon_reason: Headline-driven gap-down in a falling sector; no durable long thesis until the tape stabilizes.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Zero open positions, 0/3 weekly trades used, so no displacement; the cost is a slot. Long-side R:R at a 7-10% stop needs a bounce target of 14-20%, unlikely on a falling-knife gap-down. Space is a crowded cluster today (RKLB, LUNR, RCAT, RDW all gapping down).
